raw_constituency and name were split heuristically from OCR text using a list of honorific/title prefixes (Mr./Mrs./Sardar/Malik/Maulana/Rana/Rao/Syed/etc.) to find where the constituency label ends and the member's name begins. In a small number of entries (roughly 5-7% of general seats per assembly) the source PDF crams the constituency name and the member's name onto the same line with no separating honorific recognized by this heuristic (or the constituency name is itself an honorific-like word, e.g. 'Nawab Shah'); in those cases raw_constituency is empty and the constituency label appears as a leading fragment in 'name' instead. These were not hand-corrected.

Parse issues (entries skipped/could not confidently parse): S.No 113: source PDF omits the 'NA-<n>' seat label for this entry (likely OCR/layout artifact); seat set to null. Raw text: Sialkot-IV Mr. Ali Asj id Malhi PML (Q) 24-R, Defence Housing Authority Phase-II, Lahore

The PDF also contains post-roster tables ('MEMBERS VACATED ONE OF DOUBLE SEATS AND RETURNED', 'MEMBERS WHO JOINED OTHER POLITICAL PARTIES', 'MEMBERS WHO DIED AND RETURNED', 'MEMBERS WHO RESIGNED AND RETURNED', 'MEMBER WHO DISQUALIFIED AND RETURNED') documenting churn during the assembly's term; these were not parsed into separate member records -- only the main numbered roster (snapshot list) is represented here.

OCR text had stray internal spaces within words throughout (e.g. 'Moham m ad', 'Muham mad'); these were collapsed to normal spelling per instructions where detected. Addresses/phone numbers printed in the source were not transcribed into this JSON (not part of the requested schema).
